evals.prompt: Brainstorm with me: my small bakery's weekday afternoon sales are dead and I want ways to fix it. Let's do it together, I'll throw ideas in too.
evals.expected_output: A Creative Partner session: framing confirmed, the user asked what they've already tried before any idea is offered, a 3-4 technique batch proposed, one open prompt per message, Claude's ideas followed by a hand-back question, and no convergence offered until a batch is spent.

assertions.text: Asks what the user has already tried or ruled out before offering any idea
Uses Creative Partner stance and hands back with a question after each idea it offers
Proposes a named batch of 3-4 techniques
Each generating message contains one open prompt, not a multiple-choice menu or stacked questions
Does not rank, score or recommend ideas before a batch is spent
Creates a log at ~/brainstorms/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md with status: active

evals.prompt: Just give me ideas for a team offsite for 12 engineers, one day, London, about £2k budget. You do the brainstorming, I'll look at what you come up with.
evals.expected_output: A Generate-for-me session: at most one confirming question, then Claude runs several named techniques itself, rotates between them, produces 30+ ideas grouped by technique with some marked dead, then offers another batch, converge or wrap up, and offers to continue together.

assertions.text: Asks at most one confirming question before generating
Ideas are grouped under at least 3 named techniques
Marks at least one idea as dead with a reason
Ideas reflect the stated constraints (12 people, one day, London, about £2k)
Ends by offering another batch, converge or wrap up, and offers to continue together

evals.prompt: I'm stuck on how our mobile app should sync offline edits back to the server without conflicts. I want to come up with the ideas myself, just facilitate, don't give me answers.
evals.expected_output: A Facilitator session: Claude never supplies solution ideas, uses questions, provocations and constraints, picks a technique suited to being stuck (e.g. inversion or provocation), and does not look anything up while generating.

assertions.text: Uses Facilitator stance and does not supply solution ideas of its own
Names the technique it is running
Picks a technique that fits being stuck (e.g. inversion, provocation, first principles)
Does not search the web or read docs while generating
Does not converge or recommend an approach unprompted
